story.title: When a Volcano Lion Challenges the Apex
story.signature_move: It crawls low through the ash before exploding forward with a feline pounce to clamp its jaws.
story.hybrid_look: A long, low, armoured body with a crocodile-shaped head and lion's eyes, short sprawling legs, and a long tail ending in a dark tuft, featuring a back with osteoderm and bony scutes in tough rows mixed with fur texture.

sentences.text: This fiery beast drags its heavy armored body across boiling volcanic plains.
sentences.image: cracked black basalt fields glowing with rivers of bright orange molten lava

sentences.text: Meet the Crocadileo, an imaginary hybrid inheriting the scaly armor of a crocodile and the sharp eyes of a lion.
sentences.image: steaming sulfur vents hissing thick white plumes into a darkened hazy sky

sentences.text: A massive territorial rival steps out from the ash clouds, testing its ground.
sentences.image: towering jagged volcanic peaks rising sharply against a blood red horizon

sentences.text: Deep tracks left in the soft black pumice show the heavy creature is holding its ground.
sentences.image: scorched earth covered in fine grey ash and glowing embers

sentences.text: It crawls low through the ash before exploding forward with a feline pounce to clamp its jaws.
sentences.image: barren volcanic slopes shimmering beneath intense waves of suffocating heat

sentences.text: The rival tries to bite, but hits the tough bony scutes and thick rows of osteoderm.
sentences.image: dark obsidian cliffs surrounded by bubbling pools of red liquid rock

sentences.text: Then, a fierce bite from the crocodile jaw traps the rival, while the lion tail lash finishes the fight.
sentences.image: rugged wasteland of dark volcanic rocks under a heavy ash cloud

sentences.text: Despite its fierce nature, it cannot survive heavy rainfall because its armor traps dangerous heat. What should I combine next? Tell me in the comments.
sentences.image: steaming volcanic caldera surrounded by dark jagged obsidian walls
